items.title: Profs. Betty Ombuki-Berman and Blessing Ogbuokiri Receive Federal Research Funding
items.excerpt: Prof. Ombuki-Berman and Prof. Ogbuokiri have received federal research funding, opening new frontiers in technology and computer science research at Brock University.

items.title: Provincial Boost to Help Brock Ready Grads for Cutting-Edge STEM Careers
items.excerpt: Provincial funding will help Brock University prepare graduate students for careers at the forefront of STEM fields, supporting the next generation of researchers and innovators.
